title: A simple cause and shifting impressions
meaning: Your shared view can gain a simple explanation while your sense of familiar material keeps changing whenever you return to it.
text: An understood cause can stay the same while an impression changes. The Hermit in the physical position of Ajna suggests considering observations and sharing a conclusion clearly. The Sun in energy supports wanting to see the substance openly and simply. The Wheel of Fortune in emotions feels the overall impression’s fluidity. Both may understand an explanation while a different detail becomes prominent whenever you return to the material. Your shared view retains clear grounds while the whole feels different with changes in context and the order of attention.

For example, you examine a drawing of a road receding into the distance. After reflection, one person explains how narrowing gaps between lines create depth. **A simple explanation can remain while an impression changes.** Both see the connection. Yet the image feels alternately calm and swift depending on where you look. New understanding requires no single lasting feeling. You can clearly explain the drawing’s structure while staying interested in how its different parts repeatedly alter the overall impression.

The risk is treating every shift in feeling as a need to seek the main cause afresh. Attention returns to something already understood and loses the particular character of the current response. Wanting to see the substance preserves a distinction: the explanation of depth is accessible while changing impressions reveal other aspects of the same drawing.
